findings.detail: The billing, reporting and auth units have more than one name. The question calls them 'service directories' and 'directory', and option C calls them 'service'. The reason for option A calls them 'packages'. Use one name, for example 'service directory', everywhere.

blind_answer.reason: Putting each shared standard in a single file (e.g., standards/logging.md) and pulling it into the billing and reporting CLAUDE.md files with @import gives one source of truth, so both services stay consistent and modular. B keeps the duplication and relies on people remembering to update every copy. C loses directory-level scoping. D makes the standards personal rather than shared, and they can drift between engineers.
